rust_summary: a player drawn with a mod's own model, and layers added to mobs and players (`native_player_submit`, `native_mob_layer`, told while a mod sets `native_player_render_listened`).
doc_summary: `native_player_submit(player, who, draw, drawn)` fires once a frame for each other player in view and for this window's player in third person (not while invisible), with the `native_mob_submit` frame (`NativeMobRender`, a `BlockEntityDraw` at the feet turned with the body) and `who` (profile name, whether it is the local player); set `drawn` to leave out the vanilla model, armour, held items, cape and other layers (`RenderPlayerEvent.Pre`). `native_mob_layer(mob, who, draw)` fires once a frame after the vanilla model and layers of every mob and player in view that a mod did not draw itself, and what the mod adds in that frame is drawn with it (`EntityRenderersEvent.AddLayers`, `RenderLivingEvent.Post`); `who` is set for a player. Geometry attaches to the entity's frame, not to the model's bones: head yaw, pitch and the walk cycle are in `NativeMobRender`. A mod that hooks either also hooks `native_player_render_listened(listened)` and sets `*listened = true`: otherwise neither is asked. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_render@.
